# PHAROS

Pharos is a self-hosted personal hub for inventory, receipts, expenses, statements, subscriptions and planning. AI integrations are optional. Licensed under AGPL-3.0. No managed hosting or paid plans are offered.

- [Features](https://ph-aros.com/#features)
- [Self-hosting](https://ph-aros.com/#self-host)
- [Project status](https://ph-aros.com/status)
